content: The low accuracy is mostly due to the nature of correct answers in our data: Each correct answer has a low overlap with the text by design. Since the overlap model selects the answer with a high overlap to the text, it does not perform well. In particular, this also explains the very bad result on text-based questions. The sliding similarity window model does not outperform the simple word overlap model by a large margin: Distributional information alone is insufficient to handle complex questions in the dataset.
